title: Chunk normalization for NotebookLM report imports
description: Converts imported NotebookLM RAG appendices into metadata-only chunk candidates linked to the RAG-004 source manifest.
notes: This checkpoint creates review-only chunk candidates.
It does not import chunks into runtime memory or enable retrieval.
Source excerpt text is not copied forward; excerpts are represented only as source_excerpt_present flags.
Human review is required before any sales tactic becomes eligible for a runtime RAG knowledge base.
